messages:
Sam (CSE): Heads-up: Orbitica enabled a new internal Assist for QA (+2 teams) this morning. Early telemetry shows doubled qps and increased long-form responses; they're worried about unpredictable bills and asked about dedicated lanes / per-team quotas. cc @Yuki @Lena

Yuki (CS Ops): Can you share qps per team and sample payloads? Is this live traffic or a ramp test?

Sam (CSE): Live. QA Team A: ~60 seats, avg prompt 1.6k tokens, replies ~500. QA Team B: ~30 seats, longer transcripts ~1.9k tokens. Combined tenant qps ~380 with bursts to ~820. They saw a few throttles this morning. Renewal touchpoint in ~30 days; billing predictability is a key ask.

Mateo (Eng): Likely KV churn + batching pressure. Short-term we can add per-team concurrency caps and enable a trial pinned pool. Long-term recommend a dedicated pool for stable tail latency.

Lena (AE): I'll offer a 10-day dedicated trial focused on QA Team A. Need a rough cost delta and expected tail improvement to pass to customer execs.

Faris (Product): Noted feature asks: per-team quota UI, per-team cost estimator, and message-level team tags in logs. Adding to the backlog. Sam, can you capture exact fields they want in logs?

Sam (CSE): Will collect. Example sanitized payload:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-medium-2025",
  "messages": ["system: assist qa","user: long transcript ~1.6k tokens"],
  "max_tokens": 1000
}
```
They also requested clearer per-seat cost projection in the console.

Mateo (Eng): I'll open infra ticket INF-9112 to enable tenant pinning and a KV retention toggle. Proposed canary config for trial:
```yaml
tenant: orbitica-qa-teamA
kv_retention: extended
batch_window_ms: 20
team_concurrency: 5
pinned_pool: dedicated-trial-qa
```

Yuki (CS Ops): OPS-7788 opened to provision the trial pool. ETA ~20h.

infra-bot: Dedicated trial pool `dedicated-trial-qa` allocated to tenant orbitica-qa-teamA (expires in 10 days).

Lena (AE): I'll prepare renewal scenarios: A) seat-tier + burst credits, B) committed dedicated pool with predictable monthly cost. If trial reduces tail errors by >35% and cost delta <30%, I'll recommend option B.

Sam (CSE): Plan: 1) Mateo -> INF-9112 + apply canary, 2) Yuki -> OPS-7788 follow-up, 3) Lena -> renewal scenarios and exec brief, 4) Faris -> workup product reqs for quotas/logging. Schedule enablement with Orbitica ops after pool is live. Renewal risk: medium until trial confirms predictability. :white_check_mark:
